description: This file defines an interface 'TreeStringRenderer' for rendering various components of a tree structure into a textual or HTML representation. It specifies methods for rendering different parts of a tree node, such as begin/end of a node, labels, links, images, and the last element, as well as retrieving an associated 'ScreenStringRenderer'.

classes.name: TreeStringRenderer
classes.description: An interface that defines methods for rendering tree nodes and related elements in a textual or HTML format.

methods.name: renderNodeBegin
methods.description: Render the beginning of a tree node.

methods.name: renderNodeEnd
methods.description: Render the end of a tree node.

methods.name: renderLabel
methods.description: Render the label of a node.

methods.name: renderLink
methods.description: Render the link associated with a node.

methods.name: renderImage
methods.description: Render an image within a node.

methods.name: renderLastElement
methods.description: Render the last element of a node.

methods.name: getScreenStringRenderer
methods.description: Retrieve the associated ScreenStringRenderer based on the context.
